select cm.*, (case when WU.SHORT_NAME IS NULL OR WU.SHORT_NAME = '' OR c.SHORT_NAME IS NULL OR c.SHORT_NAME = '' then c.name else CONCAT(WU.SHORT_NAME, c.SHORT_NAME) end case) as unit_crew_name from crew_member cm left join crew c on cm.crew_id = c.ID LEFT JOIN WORK_UNIT wu on c.UNIT_ID = wu.ID
where cm.id in
#{id}
order by unit_crew_name
